raw_definitions: Definisi : pron cukup: she has ~ of everything, dia cukup segala-galanya; that’s more than ~, itu lebih drpd cukup; ~ said, cukup itu; have had ~ of , be tired of, tdk tahan lagi dgn: I’ve had ~ of your rudeness, saya sudah cukup sabar dgn sikapmu yg biadab itu; that’s ~ , /sudah, cukup/ itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : /oddly, strangely, surprisingly, curiously/ ~ , yg /peliknya, anehnya, hairannya, ganjilnya/; sure ~ , memang betul: he said she’d fall off and sure ~ she did, dia kata dia akan jatuh, memang betul dia jatuh; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adv 1. sufficiently, cukup: the vegetables aren’t cooked ~, sayur-sayur itu tdk cukup masak; is he warm ~?, adakah dia cukup panas?; you have worked hard ~, kamu telah bekerja cukup kuat; 2. fairly, agak: he knows the town well ~ not to get lost, dia agak tahu selok-belok bandar itu dan tdk akan sesat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : determiner cukup: we have ~ money to buy a new car, kami ada cukup wang utk membeli sebuah kereta baru; there is ~ bread for tomorrow, ada cukup roti utk esok; there’s not ~ time for one more game, tdk cukup waktu utk satu lagi perlawanan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
